title: BWhiteListView
description: Makes it visible only to the specified player.
body:
**Hide everyone except friends**

You can use commands to add players to the whitelist.
You can switch between whitelist mode and normal mode.

**Mode Switch**
You can set the switch key from the key settings.

**Add to whitelist**

```
/wlv add <id>
```

Changes will be reflected during gameplay.

**Remove from whitelist**

```
/wlv remove <id>
```

Changes will take effect after restarting the game.

You can apply changes by saving the UUID as a set from the configuration.
